bridge_lemma_for_external_exact_code_pai.statement: If a p-by-q parent-pair grid contains J pair edges with pairwise distinct acceptable outputs, select one edge for each distinct output. The complement has e=p*q-J edges. Deleting a vertex cover of those e complement edges removes at most e parent vertices and leaves a complete Cartesian sub-rectangle P' x Q' consisting only of selected edges; hence every remaining pair has a distinct acceptable output.

N58_historical_instantiation.witness_lower_bound_explanation: For any deletion split a+b<=6, |P'||Q'|=(22-a)(28-b); the minimum over a+b=6, 0<=a,b<=6 is 16*28=448.

bridge_lemma_for_external_exact_code_pai.use: Allows exact fully-separable/cancellative two-codebook theorems to be tested soundly against a guaranteed subrectangle rather than being rejected solely because the original N58 regime was only near-injective.
bridge_lemma_for_external_exact_code_pai.current_result: No located external exact-code-pair upper bound forbids the resulting >=448 rectangle under the full JANUS signed/partial-transversal assumptions; therefore NO_GAIN numerically.

top_new_lanes.primary: A. G. D'yachkov, N. Polyanskii, V. Shchukin, I. Vorobyev, Separable Codes for the Symmetric Multiple-Access Channel
top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: For any symmetric coordinatewise f-MAC, separability means distinct messages have distinct output vectors. The paper additionally defines almost separability by the fraction of bad messages and develops entropy/combinatorial bounds.
top_new_lanes.JANUS_translation: Use input alphabet {OMIT,POS,NEG}; define the JANUS coordinate channel to emit the signed union on compatible pairs and a conflict symbol on POS/NEG clashes. JANUS counts only all-conflict-free pair vectors, so it is a partial/rejected-output variant and has two separate codebooks P,Q.
top_new_lanes.why_priority: This is the closest located published language to the historical 610/616 near-injective regime.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: Published bounds are not stated for the exact bipartite partial channel; no numeric transfer allowed yet.

top_new_lanes.primary: Or Ordentlich, Ofer Shayevitz, An Upper Bound on the Sizes of Multiset-Union-Free Families
top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: Two families F1,F2 are multiset-union-free when every pair has a unique multiset union; the paper gives zero-error capacity-region upper bounds using soft Sauer-Perles-Shelah/shattering and information-theoretic arguments.
top_new_lanes.JANUS_translation: The guaranteed injective subrectangle can be encoded as partial-transversal subsets of 12 literal elements. Unique ordinary signed unions imply unique multiset unions, so any sound finite multiset-union-free bound may be applied as a necessary condition after this embedding.
top_new_lanes.why_priority: P and Q are native separate codebooks and coordinate marginals drive the inequalities, close to JANUS omission counts a_y,b_y,t_y.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: Main bounds are asymptotic and multiplicity retains more information; no finite contradiction at N58 was found.

top_new_lanes.primary: Mausumi Bose, Rahul Mukerjee, Union Distinct Families of Sets, with an Application to Cryptography, Ars Combinatoria 110 (2013) 179-192
top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: K-union-distinct means all unions of at most K family members are distinct; cover-free is sufficient but not necessary.
top_new_lanes.JANUS_translation: Signed tails are ordinary partial-transversal subsets in a 12-literal ground set and compatible resolvent union is literal-set union.
top_new_lanes.why_priority: Exact operation match: union uniqueness rather than sum or intersection.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: One-family/global-pair condition rather than bipartite P x Q with partial compatibility.

top_new_lanes.primary: Sebastian Ordyniak, Daniël Paulusma, Stefan Szeider, Satisfiability of acyclic and almost acyclic CNF formulas
top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: Beta-acyclic CNFs admit an elimination ordering by DP-simplicial variables whose resolvents are controlled by parent containment, preventing generic clause explosion.
top_new_lanes.JANUS_translation: Only a theorem-side structural/reachability test is relevant: ask whether a frozen reachable canonical state independently satisfies an analogous DP-simplicial local condition before elimination.
top_new_lanes.why_priority: This is a genuine exact mechanism by which DP resolvent growth collapses.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: No such structural premise is proved for N58/JANUS; post-elimination subsumption cannot be imported as a free resource.

primaries.title: New Bounds for Union-free Families of Sets

top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: Published variants relax exact cancellativity/union uniqueness and bound families avoiding specified union collisions.
top_new_lanes.why_priority: Conceptually matches near-injective output rather than perfect cancellativity.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: Known published results located so far are unsigned, one-family and mostly asymptotic. The very-close Balakirsky almost-cancellative manuscript is unpublished and is navigation only.

primaries.title: On Codes with the Identifiable Parent Property
New bounds on bar-2-separable codes of length 2
Supersaturation of C4: From Zarankiewicz towards Erdos-Simonovits-Sidorenko

top_new_lanes.theorem_or_definition: Separable/IPP codes distinguish parent pairs by coordinatewise descendant signatures; length-two cases connect to packing and C4-free bipartite graphs, with C4 supersaturation controlling near-extremal excess.
top_new_lanes.why_not_direct: Descendant signatures contain strictly more information than JANUS unions, and no proof currently maps a JANUS union collision to a C4.

discovery_lower_bound_backfill.message: The arXiv sweep missed classical proof-search literature. The dossier addendum backfills 8 primary automatability sources including Atserias-Bonet, Alekhnovich-Razborov, Iwama, Alekhnovich-Buss-Moran-Pitassi, Bell, de Rezende, Carenini-de Rezende, and Buss-Yolcu.
discovery_lower_bound_backfill.key_firewall: Effective simulation may translate the formula; it is not same-formula simulation and cannot grant JANUS extra resources.

red_result: NO_NEW_EXTERNAL_NUMERIC_N58_CLOSURE. The major gain is a sharper exact problem class and a sound bridge from historical near-injectivity to a fully injective Cartesian subrectangle.
